newsitem.title: USA: Magnetic Tech in merger deal with SPS.
newsitem.headline: Magnetic Tech in merger deal with SPS.

text.p: Magnetic Technologies Corp said on Thursday it entered a merger agreement that calls for SPS Technologies Inc to acquire the company for $5.00 per share.

The transaction, valued at about $14.4 million, is subject to approval by Magnetic shareholders, the company said in a statement. A meeting to vote on the merger has been scheduled tentatively for October, the company added.

"Five principals of Magnetic Technologies owning 26 percent of the outstanding shares have entered into agreements with SPS to vote their shares in favor of the merger at the meeting," the company said.
